rationale: The monotonicity stress held: 900 random actions at 20 percent loss produced zero decided-index decreases and zero divergences, so the crafted regression requires a more specific pattern than this schedule produced. This update records that incidence negative and submits a new axis on the same harness: a mid-run reconfigure to configuration_id 2 (same nodes), with appends tolerated after the StopSign is accepted, checking agreement and emitting a reconfigured flag so the comparison only counts runs where the reconfiguration was actually exercised.

knowledge.statement: In the seed 0x452821e638d01377 stress (900 actions, 20 percent loss, 120 appends, 370 deliveries, 103 drops), all five nodes reached decided 49, no node's decided index ever decreased from its previously observed maximum, and pairwise decided prefixes never diverged; the gated comparison (regressions 0 with progressed true) is complete and holds.
knowledge.conditions: Five OmniPaxos instances, MemoryStorage, unit batch, no snapshots or trimming; random appends, ticks and out-of-order 20 percent loss, with decided monotonicity sampled after every action and after the fair-delivery convergence.

scope.description: Five-node 900-action stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, run id 10 and 20 percent loss; at action 450 node 1 proposes a reconfigure to configuration_id 2 with the same nodes, appends that are rejected after the StopSign are skipped, and the run emits whether any node reports the reconfiguration decided.
assumptions: Messages may be delivered out of order or dropped; ticks drive elections and resends.
The reconfigure is proposed once from node 1 and may be forwarded or buffered according to its state.
The new configuration is not started; only the old cluster's StopSign behavior is exercised.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, trimming, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Same stress construction as the agreement runs, with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c and run id 10. At step 450, call nodes[0].reconfigure(ClusterConfig{configuration_id:2, nodes:[1,2,3,4,5]}, None) once; appends that return an error after the StopSign has been accepted are skipped and not counted. After every action compare decided prefixes and track decided monotonicity; after the loop run the fair-delivery convergence phase, compute progressed and whether any node reports is_reconfigured, and emit the safety event with appended, delivered, dropped, divergences, progressed, regressions, reconfigured and decided indices.

comparisons.description: Agreement when a reconfiguration is exercised: with progressed and reconfigured true, no two nodes may report different values at any index both have decided.
